[[Rocktail's Stinger]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] dropped by [[Molotov Rocktail]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Dalada Uplands]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while in a [[Stance]])
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as the [[Wyvern Blade]] dyed black.
